title: ISO 230-7:2015 — Test code for machine tools — Part 7: Geometric accuracy of axes of rotation
locator: Official catalogue abstract: rotary-axis error motion and speed-induced axis shifts; includes rotary and swivelling machine tables; confirmed in 2026
notes: Covers geometric error motion and speed-induced axis shifts. Angular positioning accuracy is treated separately under ISO 230-2; thermal effects are treated under ISO 230-3. It is not a table-face runout or gear backlash standard. Full text is not archived.
